payload.title: File:Tylosaurus (side angle).jpg
payload.artist_html: Will Beckett from Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, Canada
payload.description_html: At 9.75 metres (32 feet), this 72 million-year-old Tylosaurus saskatchewanensis roamed the ancient inland seas of central Canada. Archeologists uncovered this specimen north of Rush Lake, near Lake Diefenbaker, Saskatchewan.
